For reviewer reference, the A.A. degree section lists: Required Courses CDEV C1000 (3) or CDEV C1000H, CDEV 111 (3), CDEV 126 (3), CDEV 127 (3), CDEV 185 (3), CDEV 186 (3), CDEV 244 (3), CDEV 245 (3); Required Courses for Experience Working with Children (8 units): CDEV 215 (4), CDEV 205 (4); Total Units 32; Recommended Course: CDEV 109 (3, not in closed list).
